customer_id.meaning: primary id of the building owner's account record (content hash)

company_name.meaning: registered name of the building owner or property management company, as it appears on the service agreements

primary_contact_name.meaning: name of the facilities contact who calls the service desk

phone_number.meaning: main phone number on the account, the number the desk dials back

email.meaning: billing and dispatch email address on the account

billing_address.meaning: street address invoices are sent to, stated as one line

account_number.meaning: customer account number printed on every invoice and work order

tax_id_last4.meaning: last four digits of the company's federal tax identification number, held for credit purposes

account_opened_date.meaning: day the account was opened with the contractor

credit_terms.meaning: payment terms agreed at account level; an agreement's own terms override this where they differ

account_status.meaning: standing of the account as a whole; credit_hold blocks new work being booked

site_id.meaning: primary id of the building record

customer_id.meaning: building owner the site belongs to (foreign key -> customers)

site_name.meaning: name the building is known by, as the customer states it

site_address.meaning: street address of the building, stated as one line

building_type.meaning: use class of the building, which governs seasonal scheduling and after-hours access

square_footage.meaning: conditioned floor area of the building

access_notes_required.meaning: whether a technician needs an escort or advance access arrangement at this building

service_region.meaning: dispatch region the building falls in, which governs response commitments and travel

site_status.meaning: whether the building is still served by the contractor

equipment_id.meaning: primary id of the equipment record

site_id.meaning: building the unit is installed in (foreign key -> sites)

customer_id.meaning: building owner the unit belongs to (foreign key -> customers)

equipment_tag.meaning: tag the unit carries on the building's equipment schedule, exactly as printed on the unit (for example RTU-4)

equipment_type.meaning: kind of unit, which selects the per-type price and the applicable coverage

manufacturer.meaning: manufacturer name on the unit's data plate

model_number.meaning: model number on the unit's data plate

serial_number.meaning: serial number on the unit's data plate

install_date.meaning: day the unit was placed in service; the anchor for every equipment age count

capacity_tons.format: decimal, tons of cooling to 1 decimal place
capacity_tons.meaning: nominal cooling capacity of the unit; zero for heating-only equipment

refrigerant_type.meaning: refrigerant charged in the unit; none for equipment that holds no charge

unit_status.meaning: whether the unit is still running at the site; removed units stay on file for history

warranty_end_date.meaning: day the manufacturer's original warranty on the unit ends; empty where none is recorded

agreement_id.meaning: primary id of the maintenance agreement record

customer_id.meaning: building owner holding the agreement (foreign key -> customers)

site_id.meaning: building the agreement covers (foreign key -> sites)

variant_name.meaning: the tier held, written as the official full agreement name

status.meaning: lifecycle state of the agreement (basis defined in the charter's lifecycle.states)

proposal_date.meaning: day the proposal was issued; the anchor for the proposal validity count

signed_date.meaning: day the signed acceptance was received; empty until the agreement is signed

term_start_date.meaning: first day of the current agreement term

term_end_date.meaning: last day of the current agreement term, inclusive

term_months_quoted.meaning: term length quoted on the proposal

equipment_count.meaning: number of units on the covered equipment schedule

annual_price_usd.meaning: annual agreement price currently in force, after discounts and credits

visits_remaining.meaning: visits still available in the current term; identically the sum of the visit entitlement account's deltas

repair_allowance_remaining.meaning: repair allowance still available in the current term; identically the sum of the repair allowance account's deltas

balance_due.meaning: amount currently owed under the agreement; positive when the owner owes, identically the sum of the balance account's deltas

next_visit_due_date.meaning: day the next scheduled visit is due; empty where none is due

renewal_notice_date.meaning: day the renewal window opened and the renewal notice was sent; empty before that

suspension_date.meaning: day coverage was suspended; empty where the agreement has never been suspended

reinstatement_date.meaning: day the agreement was last put back in force; empty where it never was

cancellation_date.meaning: day the cancellation or proposal closure was recorded; empty while the agreement lives

termination_effective_date.meaning: day coverage actually stops under a termination notice; empty where none is pending

cancellation_reason.meaning: why the agreement or proposal ended; empty while it lives

last_change_type.meaning: kind of the most recent mid-term change applied to the agreement

last_change_date.meaning: day the most recent mid-term change took effect

purchase_order_ref.meaning: purchase order number the owner requires on invoices, exactly as the owner states it; empty where none is required

event_id.meaning: primary id of the maintenance event row

scheduled_date.meaning: day the visit is booked for; the anchor for the missed-visit grace count

scheduled_window.meaning: arrival window booked with the customer

completed_date.meaning: day the visit or repair was completed on site

issued_date.meaning: day the written condition report was delivered to the owner

equipment_tag.meaning: tag of the unit this row concerns, exactly as printed on the unit; empty where the row concerns the whole schedule

equipment_type.meaning: kind of unit this row concerns; empty where the row concerns the whole schedule

service_category.meaning: what kind of visit or work the row records

labor_hours.meaning: technician hours spent on site for this row

hours_band.meaning: whether the work fell in regular hours, outside them, or on a published office holiday

refrigerant_lbs.meaning: pounds of refrigerant added on this row; zero where none was added

coverage_applied.meaning: how far the agreement absorbed this repair

deductible_usd.meaning: deductible billed to the owner for this covered repair; zero where the tier carries none

amount_usd.meaning: money amount of this row, always recorded positive; the event family fixes whether it increases or reduces what the owner owes

charge_type.meaning: which kind of charge this invoice row is; empty on rows that are not charges

billing_period.format: YYYY-MM for a monthly period, YYYY-Qn for a quarterly period, YYYY for an annual period

invoice_ref.meaning: invoice number the amount was billed on or paid against

due_date.meaning: day the invoice falls due; the anchor for the late fee and suspension counts

received_date.meaning: day the payment was received in the office

credit_reason.meaning: why a credit was issued; empty on rows that are not credits

technician_ref.meaning: badge number of the technician who performed the work

request_id.meaning: primary id of the maintenance intake record

customer_id.meaning: building owner the intake concerns (foreign key -> customers)

agreement_id.meaning: agreement the intake concerns (foreign key -> maintenance_agreements); empty on a pre-agreement inspection

site_id.meaning: building the intake concerns (foreign key -> sites)

request_type.meaning: what the owner or the office lodged

outcome.meaning: how far the intake has been carried; only completed or confirmed counts as an authoritative pre-action record

work_order_ref.meaning: work order the intake was carried out under; empty where none was raised

requested_date.meaning: day the owner asked for this

notice_date.meaning: day a written notice was received in the office; the anchor for the notice period counts

effective_date.meaning: day the intake takes effect once confirmed; empty until it is fixed

created_at.format: ISO timestamp, exactly as returned by ctx.now()

verification_id.meaning: primary id of the identity verification record

customer_id.meaning: account being verified (foreign key -> customers)

verified.meaning: whether verification passed; monotonically non-decreasing once true

verified_at.format: ISO timestamp, exactly as returned by ctx.now()

handoff_id.meaning: primary id of the human handoff record

customer_id.meaning: account handed off (foreign key -> customers)

reason.meaning: reason for the handoff; closed set of exactly these two values

variant_name.meaning: the program tier held, written as its official full name

activation_date.meaning: day the program rates took effect; empty until it is signed

approval_status.meaning: whether the owner has approved the quoted work; only approved permits the work to start

invoice_ref.meaning: invoice number the amount was billed on or paid against

charge_type.meaning: which kind of charge this invoice line is; empty on rows that are not charges

billing_rate_usd.meaning: labor rate the line was computed at; empty on lines that are not labor

amount_usd.meaning: money amount of this row, always recorded positive; the event family fixes whether it increases or reduces what the owner owes

billing_period.format: YYYY-MM for a monthly period, YYYY for a program year

due_date.meaning: day the invoice falls due; the anchor for the late fee and suspension counts
